![Image 3: Pokémon: Indigo League](https://www.pokemon.com/static-assets/content-assets/cms2/img/watch-pokemon-tv/seasons/season01/season01_logo_169_en.jpg)

It’s Ash Ketchum’s tenth birthday, and he’s ready to do what many 10-year-olds in the Kanto region set out to do—become a Pokémon Trainer! Things don’t go exactly the way he planned when he ends up with a Pikachu instead of a standard first Pokémon, and winning Gym Badges turns out to be much tougher than he thought. Luckily he’s got former Gym Leaders Brock and Misty at his side, along with a bevy of new Pokémon friends, including Bulbasaur, Squirtle, and Charmander.

_Squirtle_ is a [Water](https://pokemondb.net/type/water) type Pokémon introduced in Generation 1.

_Squirtle_ is a bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. It has a blue body with purple eyes, a light brown belly, and a tough red-brown shell on its back. It has a long tail that curls into a spiral.

_Squirtle_ is primarily based on a turtle, taking inspiration from both land-dwelling and sea-dwelling varieties. The curly tail resembles a crashing wave.

_Squirtle_ is notable for being one of the three choices for a starter Pokémon in the original Game Boy games, Pokémon Red & Blue (Red & Green in Japan), along with [Bulbasaur](https://pokemondb.net/pokedex/bulbasaur) and [Charmander](https://pokemondb.net/pokedex/charmander).

_Squirtle_ is a [Water](https://pokemondb.net/type/water) type Pokémon introduced in Generation 1.

_Squirtle_ is a bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. It has a blue body with purple eyes, a light brown belly, and a tough red-brown shell on its back. It has a long tail that curls into a spiral.

_Squirtle_ is primarily based on a turtle, taking inspiration from both land-dwelling and sea-dwelling varieties. The curly tail resembles a crashing wave.

_Squirtle_ is notable for being one of the three choices for a starter Pokémon in the original Game Boy games, Pokémon Red & Blue (Red & Green in Japan), along with [Bulbasaur](https://pokemondb.net/pokedex/bulbasaur) and [Charmander](https://pokemondb.net/pokedex/charmander).

_Gyarados_ is a [Water](https://pokemondb.net/type/water)/[Flying](https://pokemondb.net/type/flying) type Pokémon introduced in Generation 1.

_Gyarados_ is a serpentine, dragon-like Pokémon. It's mostly blue, and has a long body and gaping mouth full of sharp teeth. It also has a three-pointed, dark blue crest on its head and four white, dorsal fins. It is infamous for its volatile temper, often linked with tales of destruction.

Like Magikarp, _Gyarados_ embodies a popular motif in Chinese mythology: according to legend, a carp that leaps over the Dragon Gate will transform into a dragon. Its appearance is reminiscent of traditional depictions of sea serpents and Chinese dragons.

_Gyarados_ has a Mega Evolution, available in Generation 6 games and [Pokémon Go](https://pokemondb.net/go).

_Gyarados_ is a [Water](https://pokemondb.net/type/water)/[Flying](https://pokemondb.net/type/flying) type Pokémon introduced in Generation 1.

_Gyarados_ is a serpentine, dragon-like Pokémon. It's mostly blue, and has a long body and gaping mouth full of sharp teeth. It also has a three-pointed, dark blue crest on its head and four white, dorsal fins. It is infamous for its volatile temper, often linked with tales of destruction.

Like Magikarp, _Gyarados_ embodies a popular motif in Chinese mythology: according to legend, a carp that leaps over the Dragon Gate will transform into a dragon. Its appearance is reminiscent of traditional depictions of sea serpents and Chinese dragons.

_Gyarados_ has a Mega Evolution, available in Generation 6 games and [Pokémon Go](https://pokemondb.net/go).

**Misty** (Japanese: **カスミ**_Kasumi_) is an aspiring [Water Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Type_expert "Type expert") and a former [traveling companion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_friends "Ash's friends") of [Ash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash_Ketchum "Ash Ketchum"). She is also the [Gym Leader](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader") of the [Cerulean Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_Gym "Cerulean Gym"), handing out the [Cascade Badge](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Badge#Cascade_Badge "Badge") to [Trainers](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Trainer "Pokémon Trainer") who defeat her. She specializes in [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)").

Misty journeyed with Ash through [Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto "Kanto"), the [Orange Islands](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Orange_Islands "Orange Islands"), and [Johto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Johto "Johto"), sharpening her skills as a Water-type Trainer along the way. Eventually, she decided to return home to preside over her family's Gym. After watching Ash in the [Masters Eight Tournament](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Masters_Eight_Tournament "Masters Eight Tournament"), she was inspired to go on another journey and left the Gym under her sisters' care. During her travels, she reunited and resumed traveling with Ash in _[Pokémon: To Be a Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/S25 "S25")_ until she decided to return home.

## In animation

### History

#### Pre-series

[![Image 26](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/3/39/Baby_Misty.png/220px-Baby_Misty.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Baby_Misty.png)

Baby Misty

Not much is known about Misty's early childhood other than that she grew up in [Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_City "Cerulean City") in the [Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto "Kanto") region with her [three sisters](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Sensational_Sisters "Sensational Sisters"). When she was very young, an encounter with a [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gyarados_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Gyarados (Pokémon)") at the [Cerulean Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_Gym "Cerulean Gym") led to her being frightened of them. In _[No Big Woop!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP148 "EP148")_, it was revealed that Misty used to play the tambourine as a toddler. Misty often received hand-me-down toys and clothes from her older sisters, who seemed to have been favored in their family, as seen during flashbacks in _[Princess vs. Princess](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP052 "EP052")_. Eventually, Misty became one of the [Gym Leaders](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader") of the Cerulean Gym alongside her sisters. Bullying and exclusion by her sisters led Misty to leave home and effectively leave her sisters as the Gym Leaders before _[Pokémon, I Choose You!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP001 "EP001")_, choosing to prove herself as a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Master "Pokémon Master").

#### [_Pokémon the Series: The Beginning_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series")

[![Image 27](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/9/90/Misty_Burnt_Bike.png/220px-Misty_Burnt_Bike.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_Burnt_Bike.png)

Misty carrying her burnt bike

Misty debuted in _[Pokémon, I Choose You!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP001 "EP001")_, [fishing](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fishing "Fishing") in a nearby river on [Route 1](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto_Route_1 "Kanto Route 1"). As her fishing rod snagged something, she managed to pull out not a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)") Pokémon, but [Ash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash_Ketchum "Ash Ketchum") and his injured [Pikachu](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_Pikachu "Ash's Pikachu"), who were being chased by a flock of [Spearow](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Spearow_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Spearow (Pokémon)"). After pointing Ash in the direction of the nearest [Pokémon Center](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Center "Pokémon Center"), the one in [Viridian City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Viridian_City "Viridian City"), he borrowed her [bicycle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bicycle "Bicycle"), saying that he would return it someday.

In _[Pokémon Emergency!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP002 "EP002")_, Misty appeared in the Pokémon Center after Ash dropped off his Pikachu, holding her charred bike and demanding a new one right away. She continued following Ash as he headed for [Pewter City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pewter_City "Pewter City"), telling him in _[Showdown in Pewter City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP005 "EP005")_ that she would continue following him until she was paid back for the bike.

Consequently, Misty traveled around the [Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto "Kanto")[region](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Region "Region"), the [Orange Islands](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Orange_Islands "Orange Islands"), and the [Johto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Johto "Johto") region with Ash. Earlier in the series, she mentioned getting her bicycle replaced several times. By the end of the [Indigo League](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Indigo_League "Indigo League"), however, Misty seemed to have forgotten about the bicycle, indicating that her real reason for following along with Ash was that she simply wanted to remain with her friends. While traveling with Ash, Misty often acted as his coach in [Pokémon battles](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_battle "Pokémon battle").

Ash and Misty were later joined by [Brock](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brock_(anime) "Brock (anime)"), from _Showdown in Pewter City_ to _[Poké Ball Peril](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP083 "EP083")_ and again from the end of _[The Rivalry Revival](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP116 "EP116")_ to the end of the original series, and [Tracey](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tracey_Sketchit "Tracey Sketchit") from _[The Lost Lapras](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP084 "EP084")_ to _The Rivalry Revival_. When she and Brock were both traveling with Ash, Misty would pull Brock away by his ear when he approached a beautiful woman. This began in _[The Bridge Bike Gang](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP036 "EP036")_ and _[Lights, Camera, Quack-tion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP069 "EP069")_, and became far more frequent while they were in Johto.

[![Image 28](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/f/f9/Misty_Daisy_Violet_Lily.png/220px-Misty_Daisy_Violet_Lily.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_Daisy_Violet_Lily.png)

Misty with Daisy, Violet, and Lily

In _[The Water Flowers of Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP007 "EP007")_, Misty challenged Ash to a [Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym "Gym") battle after her sisters at the Cerulean Gym nearly gave Ash a [Cascade Badge](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Badge#Cascade_Badge "Badge") without a battle and to prove she was as good a Pokémon Trainer as her sisters. Ash and Misty each defeated one Pokémon, but [Team Rocket](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket_trio "Team Rocket trio") interrupted the match when they tried to steal the Gym's Water Pokémon. Misty's sisters awarded Ash a Badge when Pikachu saved the Gym with its [Thunderbolt](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Thunderbolt_(move) "Thunderbolt (move)"), over Misty's objections.

In _[Tentacool & Tentacruel](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP019 "EP019")_, while waiting for the next ferry to the mainland, Misty saw a large group of [Tentacool](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tentacool_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Tentacool (Pokémon)") and a [giant](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Giant_Pok%C3%A9mon "Giant Pokémon")[Tentacruel](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tentacruel_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Tentacruel (Pokémon)") attacking [Porta Vista](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Porta_Vista "Porta Vista") after human activity destroyed their homes. She convinced the Tentacool and Tentacruel to stop attacking the port, and the humans would no longer occupy Tentacool and Tentacruel's homes in the reef and caught a [Horsea](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Horsea "Misty's Horsea") as well.

Misty became the first main character to look after a [baby Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Baby_Pok%C3%A9mon "Baby Pokémon") in _[Who Gets to Keep Togepi?](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP050 "EP050")_, when the egg that Ash had found in _[Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP046 "EP046")_ hatches into a [Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Togepi "Misty's Togepi"). It imprinted on Misty as its mother when she became the first thing it saw, even after Ash won a tournament to decide who got to keep it. Misty would carry Togepi around without a Poké Ball for the rest of the series.

In _[Misty Meets Her Match](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP103 "EP103")_, Misty was given a chance to stay in the [Orange Islands](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Orange_Islands "Orange Islands") when [Rudy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Rudy "Rudy"), the Gym Leader on [Trovita Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trovita_Island "Trovita Island"), offered to let her stay with him. Misty considered the offer, but she ultimately chose to keep traveling with Ash and supported him in his battle against Rudy.

#### [_Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series")

In _[Hook, Line, and Stinker](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP168 "EP168")_, Misty competed in the annual [Seaking Catching Competition](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Seaking_Catching_Competition "Seaking Catching Competition"). After Misty and [Andreas](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Andreas "Andreas") both caught [Seaking](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Seaking_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Seaking (Pokémon)") that weighed 55 kg., they battled each other to break the tie. Misty won the competition after her [Poliwhirl](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Poliwhirl "Misty's Poliwhirl") defeated Andreas' [Poliwrath](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Poliwrath_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Poliwrath (Pokémon)").

[![Image 29](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/3/3f/Misty_and_Trinity.png/220px-Misty_and_Trinity.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_and_Trinity.png)

Misty and Trinity

Misty participated in the [Whirl Cup](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Whirl_Cup "Whirl Cup") alongside Ash from _[Octillery the Outcast](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP215 "EP215")_ to _[The Perfect Match!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP217 "EP217")_. She defeated Ash in the second round and made it to the best eight of the competition before she lost to [Trinity](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trinity "Trinity").

In _[Just Add Water](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP256 "EP256")_, Misty met a Water-type Trainer named [Dorian](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dorian "Dorian"), after discovering that he is a fan of her sisters, Misty challenged him to a battle. After defeating Team Rocket and ending her battle with Dorian in a draw, Dorian was impressed with Misty's battle skills.

In _[Gotta Catch Ya Later!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP273 "EP273")_, Misty returned to the Viridian City Pokémon Center and learned that her bicycle was repaired by the city's [Nurse Joy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Nurse_Joy "Nurse Joy"). Misty was shown to be sad that she no longer had the convenient excuse to travel with Ash — especially when she saw that Ash hadn't learned that and had assumed she followed him because of her bike. In addition, her sisters [Daisy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Daisy_(anime) "Daisy (anime)"), [Lily](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Lily_(Kanto) "Lily (Kanto)"), and [Violet](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Violet_(anime) "Violet (anime)"), called Misty at this time to tell her they were going on a world tour, and needed her to return to Cerulean and watch the Gym in their absence. However, Misty saw how Ash truly cared for her when he saved her from a trio of [Pokémon gangsters](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Invincible_Pok%C3%A9mon_Brothers "Invincible Pokémon Brothers"). Misty wanted to stay with Ash, but felt it was her responsibility to take over the Gym, which would be shut down if it was left unattended.

Upon the return of her sisters, Misty remained the sole Cerulean [Gym Leader](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader"). Since their return, only Daisy appears to spend a significant amount of time at the Gym. While working in the Gym, Misty sometimes receives help from Tracey when he is either visiting or running an errand for [Professor Oak](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Oak_(anime) "Professor Oak (anime)").

#### [_Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire")

[![Image 30](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b1/Misty_AG.png/220px-Misty_AG.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_AG.png)

Misty in [_Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire")

Misty was first mentioned by Ash in _[Tree's a Crowd](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG007 "AG007")_.

She reappeared from _[The Princess and the Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG044 "AG044")_ to _[A Togepi Mirage!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG045 "AG045")_, where she met up with Ash and Brock again in [Hoenn](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hoenn "Hoenn"), along with meeting [May](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/May_(anime) "May (anime)") and [Max](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Max "Max") for the first time. In _A Togepi Mirage_, her [Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Togepi_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Togepi (Pokémon)")[evolved](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") into a [Togetic](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Togetic "Misty's Togetic") and helped defend the [Togepi Paradise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Togepi_Paradise "Togepi Paradise"). Towards the end of the episode, Togetic decided to stay with the other Togepi to protect them, sharing one last tearful moment with Misty.

She watched Ash compete in the [Ever Grande Conference](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ever_Grande_Conference "Ever Grande Conference") in _[Saved by the Beldum](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG126 "AG126")_ and _[Shocks and Bonds](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG128 "AG128")_. She traveled with Ash from _[The Scheme Team](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG132 "AG132")_ to _[A Real Cleffa-Hanger](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG134 "AG134")_, and was later invited to the [Mirage Mansion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mirage_Mansion "Mirage Mansion") by [Dr. Yung](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dr._Yung "Dr. Yung") in _[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/The\_Mastermind\_of\_Mirage\_Pok%C3%A9mon "The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon")_. She later appeared in flashbacks in _[Gathering the Gang of Four](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG189 "AG189")_.

It was revealed in _[Cerulean Blues](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS02 "HS02")_ that Misty feared [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gyarados_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Gyarados (Pokémon)"), having climbed into one's mouth as a baby, and that she doubted her own ability to run Cerulean Gym alone. It wasn't until she selflessly protected her [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Gyarados "Misty's Gyarados") from a [Poison Sting](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Poison_Sting_(move) "Poison Sting (move)") assault that she was not only able to conquer her fears but regain the confidence to run the Gym with a now-obedient Gyarados.

#### [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon")

[![Image 31](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/bd/Misty_showcasing_her_Key_Stone.png/250px-Misty_showcasing_her_Key_Stone.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_showcasing_her_Key_Stone.png)

Misty and her Key Stone

Misty made recurring appearances during [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon"), starting with _[Alola, Kanto!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM042 "SM042")_. Misty and Brock reunited with Ash when he and [his classmates](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_friends "Ash's friends") arrived at the Kanto airport, then compared Kantonian and [Alolan](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Alolan_form "Alolan form") Pokémon with the class at [Professor Oak's lab](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Oak%27s_Laboratory "Professor Oak's Laboratory"). Later, Misty and the rest of the group worked together to defeat [Team Rocket](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket_trio "Team Rocket trio"), who Misty was angry to find were still stealing Pokémon. Afterward, the group had a party and learned from [Professor Kukui](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Kukui_(anime) "Professor Kukui (anime)") that the class had plans to head to [Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_City "Cerulean City") for a Gym battle.

In _[When Regions Collide!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM043 "SM043")_, the group arrived at Cerulean City, where Misty and Brock assisted Professor Kukui's lecture on the mechanics of Gym battles and the [Pokémon League](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_League "Pokémon League"). Misty nearly defeated [Lana](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Lana_(anime) "Lana (anime)") and [Mallow](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mallow_(anime) "Mallow (anime)") in a two-on-one battle, but stopped the match before the final blow could be delivered. She then battled against Ash and his [Pikachu](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_Pikachu "Ash's Pikachu") with her [Mega](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mega_Evolution "Mega Evolution")[Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Gyarados "Misty's Gyarados") and lost. She and Brock bade Ash and his classmates farewell and accepted Ash's offer to visit Alola sometime in the future.

[![Image 32](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b2/Lana_and_Misty.png/250px-Lana_and_Misty.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Lana_and_Misty.png)

Misty and Lana

During the time that passed after the visit to Alola, Misty and Lana became close friends, exchanging messages with each other.

In _[Alola, Alola!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM102 "SM102")_, Misty and Brock visited Ash and his classmates in [Alola](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Alola "Alola") after Lana invited them. She also explained that her sisters took charge, and implied that the Cerulean Gym was facing enough challengers that she simply needed a break. Whilst Brock remained at the Pokémon Center, Misty accompanied Ash and the others to [Treasure Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Treasure_Island "Treasure Island"), where they enjoyed [Mantine Surfing](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mantine_Surf "Mantine Surf") and playing with the Pokémon before the villainous obstacle Team Rocket trio attempted to steal the [Mantine](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mantine_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Mantine (Pokémon)"). However, with the help of Gyarados and several [Z-Moves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Z-Move "Z-Move"), she and the others managed to blast Team Rocket off, foiling their every plan.

In _[Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM103 "SM103")_, Misty accompanied Ash, his classmates, and Brock to [Akala Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Akala_Island "Akala Island") where they visited [Paniola Ranch](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Paniola_Ranch "Paniola Ranch") and later met [island kahuna](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Island_kahuna "Island kahuna")[Olivia](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Olivia "Olivia"). At the end of the episode, Brock and Misty left Alola to return to Kanto, although not before expressing interest in visiting Alola again.

### Character

[![Image 36](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/27/The_gang.png/220px-The_gang.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:The_gang.png)

Misty and her friends

Misty is a girl who can be sweet and optimistic at times, but she is best known for her vocal frustrations and seething anger. Misty also tended to get very angry whenever [Ash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash_Ketchum "Ash Ketchum") got their party lost, especially in forests. She is very extreme in most of her moods, and she abruptly switches between her emotions. However, as time went on, Misty mellowed and her hyperactive personality was reduced significantly by the end of the [original series](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series"). In the Japanese version, she uses the pronoun Atashi in reference to herself.

She is also picky, sensitive, nosy, and grumpy about love. There are many episodes where she is seen getting along with the younger siblings of the family, namely [Mikey](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mikey "Mikey"), [Sakura](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Sakura "Sakura"), and [Max](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Max "Max"). This stems from the fact that she understands what it's like to be the youngest because she has three older sisters.

She is shown to have a somewhat vain side to her, often referring to herself as an "internationally known beauty" (**世界の美少女**_the world's most beautiful girl_) in introductions to others. It is implied that this trait was a result of her inferiority complex towards her older sisters. However, this trait was mostly excluded from the [dub](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dub "Dub") until [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon").

[![Image 37](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b4/Misty_and_Ash_Oshawott.png/250px-Misty_and_Ash_Oshawott.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_and_Ash_Oshawott.png)

Misty showing her love for Water-type Pokémon

Her goals are not as clear as those of the other main characters (with the possible exception of Ash), but her main interest is [training](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_training "Pokémon training")[Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") with the dream of becoming a Water [Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Master "Pokémon Master"). Misty aggressively defends the Water-type against critics as seen in _[The School of Hard Knocks](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP009 "EP009")_ and when she first met [Fire](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fire_(type) "Fire (type)") enthusiast [Macy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Macy "Macy"). She considers all members of the Water-type to be "cute", though her positive opinion on [Tentacool](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tentacool_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Tentacool (Pokémon)") in _[Tentacool and Tentacruel](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP019 "EP019")_ divided Ash and [Brock](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brock_(anime) "Brock (anime)"). [Fishing](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fishing "Fishing") is one of her hobbies, and she even has a [special lure](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_special_lure "Misty's special lure"), which she designed to look like herself. In _[The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG187 "AG187")_, she sent one to Ash as a gift. Sometime before she left for Kanto at the end of _[Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM103 "SM103")_, Misty gave Lana another one as thanks for inviting her and Brock to visit Alola.

[![Image 38](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/5/53/Misty_Cascade_Badge.png/250px-Misty_Cascade_Badge.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_Cascade_Badge.png)

Misty holding a Cascade Badge

Misty's battle style was first showcased in _[The Water Flowers of Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP007 "EP007")_, where she challenged Ash. She had her [Staryu](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Staryu "Misty's Staryu") dive into the water to wash off [Butterfree](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_Butterfree "Ash's Butterfree")'s [status](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Status_condition "Status condition")-inducing [moves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Move "Move"). Misty has developed a more rounded battle strategy since becoming the full-time Cerulean Gym Leader, mirroring many of Ash's methods. During [_Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire"), Misty was shown to become increasingly confident and focused on her role as the Cerulean [Gym Leader](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader"). _[Cerulean Blues](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS02 "HS02")_ saw her overcome her fear and help calm a raging [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Gyarados "Misty's Gyarados") which now serves as one of her main Pokémon, while Misty learned about the Gym Badge-making process and began to appreciate her role in _[The Blue Badge of Courage](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS05 "HS05")_. She continues to improve her Pokémon as seen with [Psyduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Psyduck "Misty's Psyduck")'s mastery of [Water Gun](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_Gun_(move) "Water Gun (move)") and her [Corsola](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Corsola "Misty's Corsola")'s strong defenses make for a tireless battle.

[![Image 39](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/8/8d/Misty_fear_of_bugs.png/250px-Misty_fear_of_bugs.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_fear_of_bugs.png)

Misty showing her fear of Bug Pokémon

The one Pokémon [type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Type "Type") that Misty cannot stand are [Bug-types](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bug_(type) "Bug (type)"), as shown in _[Ash Catches a Pokémon!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP003 "EP003")_ and more recently in _[A Squad’s Worth of Passion!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN141 "JN141")_. The only Bug-type Pokémon Misty is not afraid of are the kinds that she deems "cute" or "pretty", like [Ledyba](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ledyba_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Ledyba (Pokémon)") and [Butterfree](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Butterfree_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Butterfree (Pokémon)"), some belonging to her friends, like [Tracey's Venonat](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tracey%27s_Venonat "Tracey's Venonat"), or ones that don't look like bugs, such as [Pineco](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pineco_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Pineco (Pokémon)"). However, Bug Pokémon are only one of three things Misty strongly dislikes, the other two being [carrots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/carrot "wp:carrot") and [peppers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bell_pepper "wp:Bell pepper"). When asked how she feels about dual-typed Bug/Water Pokémon, such as [Dewpider](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dewpider_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Dewpider (Pokémon)"), Misty replied "that's a tough one".

Her catchphrase when sending out a Pokémon is (**いくわよ！マーイステディ！**_Go! My Steady!_). Like her "beauty" title, this was not carried over into the dub until _Sun & Moon_.

Early into the series, she was shown to have a more pragmatic view on battling, which is best demonstrated in the third episode where she agreed to Ash fighting against Team Rocket despite the specific battle technically being illegal because it ultimately had the best chances of Ash not losing quickly, and also her disappointment that Ash proceeded to forfeit against Brock instead of taking the lucky advantage against him during his rematch.

### Pokémon

[![Image 40](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/9/90/Misty_party_JN.png/250px-Misty_party_JN.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_party_JN.png)

Misty and some of her Pokémon in [_Pokémon Journeys: The Series_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Journeys:_The_Series "Pokémon Journeys: The Series")

Either through the tradition of her family's Gym or merely her love of them, Misty prefers to train [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)") Pokémon. She usually bases her choice of Pokémon to train by looks, preferring Pokémon that she thinks of as "cute" over ones that she thinks are "ugly," but is willing to overcome such differences.

Her love of Water Pokémon stems from the fact that they are extremely flexible in battle, meaning that they can easily adapt to the opponent, as she stated in _[Some Like It Hot](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP240 "EP240")_. Since becoming a Gym Leader, she has overcome her fear of [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gyarados_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Gyarados (Pokémon)") and continues to learn more about caring and battling with Water Pokémon as challengers come to the [Cerulean Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_Gym "Cerulean Gym").

As an experienced Water-type Pokémon Trainer, Misty has access to many powerful Pokémon and mechanics such as [Mega Evolution](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mega_Evolution "Mega Evolution"). This allows her to be able to battle other powerful Trainers like [Dorian](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dorian "Dorian"), [Trinity](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trinity "Trinity"), or Ash in equal conditions.

Misty befriends a [Golduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Golduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Golduck (Pokémon)") which lives on [Kinnow Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kinnow_Island "Kinnow Island") who she mistakes for thinking that her [Psyduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Psyduck "Misty's Psyduck") had [evolved](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution"). He was first seen under Misty's [backpack](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bag "Bag") and after Misty had found him she used him in a battle against [Marina](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Marina_(EP091) "Marina (EP091)") and her [Psyduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Psyduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Psyduck (Pokémon)"). Psyduck used Confusion on a wave which Golduck rode and was about to crash into Psyduck until [Team Rocket](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket_trio "Team Rocket trio") appeared and nabbed Marina's Pokémon. He was used with Marina's [Starmie](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Starmie_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Starmie (Pokémon)") to get them back and Golduck throws [Team Rocket's sub](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket%27s_mechas "Team Rocket's mechas") onto the beach. He hits the sub with a Water Gun, and stops [Arbok](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Jessie%27s_Arbok "Jessie's Arbok")'s attack with Disable and then slams Arbok to the floor with a Psychic, and eventually send Team Rocket blasting off with a [Hyper Beam](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hyper_Beam_(move) "Hyper Beam (move)") and saves Marina's Pokémon.

He was later used in the last part of the battle between Marina and her Starmie, he gets battered with Starmie's [Tackle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tackle_(move) "Tackle (move)") and [Bubble](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bubble_(move) "Bubble (move)") but shatters Starmie's [Light Screen](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Light_Screen_(move) "Light Screen (move)") with another Hyper Beam fainting it. Misty tries to recall Golduck but her Psyduck pops out. Golduck runs off and shows off his skills to a bunch of girls.

Golduck's known moves are [Surf](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Surf_(move) "Surf (move)")*, [Water Gun](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_Gun_(move) "Water Gun (move)"), [Disable](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Disable_(move) "Disable (move)"), [Confusion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Confusion_(move) "Confusion (move)"), [Psychic](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Psychic_(move) "Psychic (move)")*, [Fury Swipes](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fury_Swipes_(move) "Fury Swipes (move)"), and [Hyper Beam](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hyper_Beam_(move) "Hyper Beam (move)").

### Main outfits

[![Image 68](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/f/fb/Misty_SM.png/120px-Misty_SM.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_SM.png)

Misty's main outfit

#### Original series

Misty's first outfit, and her best known, is a yellow crop top and jean shorts held up by red suspenders. Most of her midriff is exposed. She wears red, yellow and white sneakers with it, and carries a red drawstring backpack.

This outfit also debuted her hairstyle, which is typically how she always wears it, regardless of her outfit: a small side ponytail. In [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon"), Misty holds a [Key Stone](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Key_Stone "Key Stone") on her hairband. She occasionally takes her hair down, but only when she is sleeping, bathing, or wearing a formal outfit of some sort. With her mermaid outfit, she wears her hair down with pearl ornaments.

Misty wore this outfit from _[Pokémon - I Choose You!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP001 "EP001")_ to _[A Date With Delcatty](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS11 "HS11")_. She returned to wearing this outfit in _[Alola, Kanto!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM042 "SM042")_.

#### _Ruby and Sapphire_

[![Image 69](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b1/Misty_AG.png/200px-Misty_AG.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_AG.png)

Misty's [_Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire") outfit

Misty's second outfit is a yellow sleeveless top or vest with a large blue button on the front and matching shorts, worn over some sort of dark red under-all (swimsuit or leotard, etc.). She wears short pale and burnt orange ankle boots with it. Misty changed bags three times while wearing this outfit. She had her red drawstring bag from her original outfit from _[The Princess and the Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG044 "AG044")_ to _[A Togepi Mirage!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG045 "AG045")_, a [Spheal](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Spheal_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Spheal (Pokémon)")-shaped backpack from _[The Right Place and the Right Mime](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG133 "AG133")_ to _[A Real Cleffa-Hanger](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG134 "AG134")_, and a pink purse in _[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/The\_Mastermind\_of\_Mirage\_Pok%C3%A9mon "The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon")_.

Misty wore this outfit from _The Princess and the Togepi_ to _The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon_.

*   Misty wears a mermaid outfit when performing at the Cerulean Gym. It was first seen in _[The Misty Mermaid](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP061 "EP061")_. The outfit consists of a shell-pattern bikini top, a light blue mermaid fin, and a pearl ornament.
*   Misty wore a [Slowpoke](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Slowpoke_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Slowpoke (Pokémon)") costume in _[A Shadow of a Drought](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP142 "EP142")_.

**Misty** (Japanese: **カスミ**_Kasumi_) is an aspiring [Water Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Type_expert "Type expert") and a former [traveling companion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_friends "Ash's friends") of [Ash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash_Ketchum "Ash Ketchum"). She is also the [Gym Leader](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader") of the [Cerulean Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_Gym "Cerulean Gym"), handing out the [Cascade Badge](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Badge#Cascade_Badge "Badge") to [Trainers](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Trainer "Pokémon Trainer") who defeat her. She specializes in [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)").

Misty journeyed with Ash through [Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto "Kanto"), the [Orange Islands](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Orange_Islands "Orange Islands"), and [Johto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Johto "Johto"), sharpening her skills as a Water-type Trainer along the way. Eventually, she decided to return home to preside over her family's Gym. After watching Ash in the [Masters Eight Tournament](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Masters_Eight_Tournament "Masters Eight Tournament"), she was inspired to go on another journey and left the Gym under her sisters' care. During her travels, she reunited and resumed traveling with Ash in _[Pokémon: To Be a Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/S25 "S25")_ until she decided to return home.

## In animation

### History

#### Pre-series

[![Image 26](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/3/39/Baby_Misty.png/220px-Baby_Misty.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Baby_Misty.png)

Baby Misty

Not much is known about Misty's early childhood other than that she grew up in [Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_City "Cerulean City") in the [Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto "Kanto") region with her [three sisters](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Sensational_Sisters "Sensational Sisters"). When she was very young, an encounter with a [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gyarados_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Gyarados (Pokémon)") at the [Cerulean Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_Gym "Cerulean Gym") led to her being frightened of them. In _[No Big Woop!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP148 "EP148")_, it was revealed that Misty used to play the tambourine as a toddler. Misty often received hand-me-down toys and clothes from her older sisters, who seemed to have been favored in their family, as seen during flashbacks in _[Princess vs. Princess](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP052 "EP052")_. Eventually, Misty became one of the [Gym Leaders](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader") of the Cerulean Gym alongside her sisters. Bullying and exclusion by her sisters led Misty to leave home and effectively leave her sisters as the Gym Leaders before _[Pokémon, I Choose You!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP001 "EP001")_, choosing to prove herself as a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Master "Pokémon Master").

#### [_Pokémon the Series: The Beginning_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series")

[![Image 27](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/9/90/Misty_Burnt_Bike.png/220px-Misty_Burnt_Bike.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_Burnt_Bike.png)

Misty carrying her burnt bike

Misty debuted in _[Pokémon, I Choose You!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP001 "EP001")_, [fishing](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fishing "Fishing") in a nearby river on [Route 1](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto_Route_1 "Kanto Route 1"). As her fishing rod snagged something, she managed to pull out not a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)") Pokémon, but [Ash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash_Ketchum "Ash Ketchum") and his injured [Pikachu](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_Pikachu "Ash's Pikachu"), who were being chased by a flock of [Spearow](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Spearow_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Spearow (Pokémon)"). After pointing Ash in the direction of the nearest [Pokémon Center](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Center "Pokémon Center"), the one in [Viridian City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Viridian_City "Viridian City"), he borrowed her [bicycle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bicycle "Bicycle"), saying that he would return it someday.

In _[Pokémon Emergency!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP002 "EP002")_, Misty appeared in the Pokémon Center after Ash dropped off his Pikachu, holding her charred bike and demanding a new one right away. She continued following Ash as he headed for [Pewter City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pewter_City "Pewter City"), telling him in _[Showdown in Pewter City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP005 "EP005")_ that she would continue following him until she was paid back for the bike.

Consequently, Misty traveled around the [Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto "Kanto")[region](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Region "Region"), the [Orange Islands](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Orange_Islands "Orange Islands"), and the [Johto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Johto "Johto") region with Ash. Earlier in the series, she mentioned getting her bicycle replaced several times. By the end of the [Indigo League](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Indigo_League "Indigo League"), however, Misty seemed to have forgotten about the bicycle, indicating that her real reason for following along with Ash was that she simply wanted to remain with her friends. While traveling with Ash, Misty often acted as his coach in [Pokémon battles](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_battle "Pokémon battle").

Ash and Misty were later joined by [Brock](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brock_(anime) "Brock (anime)"), from _Showdown in Pewter City_ to _[Poké Ball Peril](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP083 "EP083")_ and again from the end of _[The Rivalry Revival](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP116 "EP116")_ to the end of the original series, and [Tracey](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tracey_Sketchit "Tracey Sketchit") from _[The Lost Lapras](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP084 "EP084")_ to _The Rivalry Revival_. When she and Brock were both traveling with Ash, Misty would pull Brock away by his ear when he approached a beautiful woman. This began in _[The Bridge Bike Gang](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP036 "EP036")_ and _[Lights, Camera, Quack-tion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP069 "EP069")_, and became far more frequent while they were in Johto.

[![Image 28](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/f/f9/Misty_Daisy_Violet_Lily.png/220px-Misty_Daisy_Violet_Lily.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_Daisy_Violet_Lily.png)

Misty with Daisy, Violet, and Lily

In _[The Water Flowers of Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP007 "EP007")_, Misty challenged Ash to a [Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym "Gym") battle after her sisters at the Cerulean Gym nearly gave Ash a [Cascade Badge](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Badge#Cascade_Badge "Badge") without a battle and to prove she was as good a Pokémon Trainer as her sisters. Ash and Misty each defeated one Pokémon, but [Team Rocket](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket_trio "Team Rocket trio") interrupted the match when they tried to steal the Gym's Water Pokémon. Misty's sisters awarded Ash a Badge when Pikachu saved the Gym with its [Thunderbolt](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Thunderbolt_(move) "Thunderbolt (move)"), over Misty's objections.

In _[Tentacool & Tentacruel](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP019 "EP019")_, while waiting for the next ferry to the mainland, Misty saw a large group of [Tentacool](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tentacool_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Tentacool (Pokémon)") and a [giant](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Giant_Pok%C3%A9mon "Giant Pokémon")[Tentacruel](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tentacruel_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Tentacruel (Pokémon)") attacking [Porta Vista](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Porta_Vista "Porta Vista") after human activity destroyed their homes. She convinced the Tentacool and Tentacruel to stop attacking the port, and the humans would no longer occupy Tentacool and Tentacruel's homes in the reef and caught a [Horsea](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Horsea "Misty's Horsea") as well.

Misty became the first main character to look after a [baby Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Baby_Pok%C3%A9mon "Baby Pokémon") in _[Who Gets to Keep Togepi?](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP050 "EP050")_, when the egg that Ash had found in _[Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP046 "EP046")_ hatches into a [Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Togepi "Misty's Togepi"). It imprinted on Misty as its mother when she became the first thing it saw, even after Ash won a tournament to decide who got to keep it. Misty would carry Togepi around without a Poké Ball for the rest of the series.

In _[Misty Meets Her Match](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP103 "EP103")_, Misty was given a chance to stay in the [Orange Islands](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Orange_Islands "Orange Islands") when [Rudy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Rudy "Rudy"), the Gym Leader on [Trovita Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trovita_Island "Trovita Island"), offered to let her stay with him. Misty considered the offer, but she ultimately chose to keep traveling with Ash and supported him in his battle against Rudy.

#### [_Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series")

In _[Hook, Line, and Stinker](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP168 "EP168")_, Misty competed in the annual [Seaking Catching Competition](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Seaking_Catching_Competition "Seaking Catching Competition"). After Misty and [Andreas](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Andreas "Andreas") both caught [Seaking](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Seaking_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Seaking (Pokémon)") that weighed 55 kg., they battled each other to break the tie. Misty won the competition after her [Poliwhirl](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Poliwhirl "Misty's Poliwhirl") defeated Andreas' [Poliwrath](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Poliwrath_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Poliwrath (Pokémon)").

[![Image 29](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/3/3f/Misty_and_Trinity.png/220px-Misty_and_Trinity.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_and_Trinity.png)

Misty and Trinity

Misty participated in the [Whirl Cup](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Whirl_Cup "Whirl Cup") alongside Ash from _[Octillery the Outcast](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP215 "EP215")_ to _[The Perfect Match!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP217 "EP217")_. She defeated Ash in the second round and made it to the best eight of the competition before she lost to [Trinity](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trinity "Trinity").

In _[Just Add Water](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP256 "EP256")_, Misty met a Water-type Trainer named [Dorian](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dorian "Dorian"), after discovering that he is a fan of her sisters, Misty challenged him to a battle. After defeating Team Rocket and ending her battle with Dorian in a draw, Dorian was impressed with Misty's battle skills.

In _[Gotta Catch Ya Later!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP273 "EP273")_, Misty returned to the Viridian City Pokémon Center and learned that her bicycle was repaired by the city's [Nurse Joy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Nurse_Joy "Nurse Joy"). Misty was shown to be sad that she no longer had the convenient excuse to travel with Ash — especially when she saw that Ash hadn't learned that and had assumed she followed him because of her bike. In addition, her sisters [Daisy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Daisy_(anime) "Daisy (anime)"), [Lily](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Lily_(Kanto) "Lily (Kanto)"), and [Violet](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Violet_(anime) "Violet (anime)"), called Misty at this time to tell her they were going on a world tour, and needed her to return to Cerulean and watch the Gym in their absence. However, Misty saw how Ash truly cared for her when he saved her from a trio of [Pokémon gangsters](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Invincible_Pok%C3%A9mon_Brothers "Invincible Pokémon Brothers"). Misty wanted to stay with Ash, but felt it was her responsibility to take over the Gym, which would be shut down if it was left unattended.

Upon the return of her sisters, Misty remained the sole Cerulean [Gym Leader](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader"). Since their return, only Daisy appears to spend a significant amount of time at the Gym. While working in the Gym, Misty sometimes receives help from Tracey when he is either visiting or running an errand for [Professor Oak](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Oak_(anime) "Professor Oak (anime)").

#### [_Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire")

[![Image 30](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b1/Misty_AG.png/220px-Misty_AG.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_AG.png)

Misty in [_Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire")

Misty was first mentioned by Ash in _[Tree's a Crowd](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG007 "AG007")_.

She reappeared from _[The Princess and the Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG044 "AG044")_ to _[A Togepi Mirage!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG045 "AG045")_, where she met up with Ash and Brock again in [Hoenn](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hoenn "Hoenn"), along with meeting [May](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/May_(anime) "May (anime)") and [Max](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Max "Max") for the first time. In _A Togepi Mirage_, her [Togepi](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Togepi_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Togepi (Pokémon)")[evolved](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") into a [Togetic](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Togetic "Misty's Togetic") and helped defend the [Togepi Paradise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Togepi_Paradise "Togepi Paradise"). Towards the end of the episode, Togetic decided to stay with the other Togepi to protect them, sharing one last tearful moment with Misty.

She watched Ash compete in the [Ever Grande Conference](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ever_Grande_Conference "Ever Grande Conference") in _[Saved by the Beldum](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG126 "AG126")_ and _[Shocks and Bonds](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG128 "AG128")_. She traveled with Ash from _[The Scheme Team](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG132 "AG132")_ to _[A Real Cleffa-Hanger](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG134 "AG134")_, and was later invited to the [Mirage Mansion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mirage_Mansion "Mirage Mansion") by [Dr. Yung](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dr._Yung "Dr. Yung") in _[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/The\_Mastermind\_of\_Mirage\_Pok%C3%A9mon "The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon")_. She later appeared in flashbacks in _[Gathering the Gang of Four](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG189 "AG189")_.

It was revealed in _[Cerulean Blues](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS02 "HS02")_ that Misty feared [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gyarados_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Gyarados (Pokémon)"), having climbed into one's mouth as a baby, and that she doubted her own ability to run Cerulean Gym alone. It wasn't until she selflessly protected her [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Gyarados "Misty's Gyarados") from a [Poison Sting](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Poison_Sting_(move) "Poison Sting (move)") assault that she was not only able to conquer her fears but regain the confidence to run the Gym with a now-obedient Gyarados.

#### [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon")

[![Image 31](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/bd/Misty_showcasing_her_Key_Stone.png/250px-Misty_showcasing_her_Key_Stone.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_showcasing_her_Key_Stone.png)

Misty and her Key Stone

Misty made recurring appearances during [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon"), starting with _[Alola, Kanto!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM042 "SM042")_. Misty and Brock reunited with Ash when he and [his classmates](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_friends "Ash's friends") arrived at the Kanto airport, then compared Kantonian and [Alolan](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Alolan_form "Alolan form") Pokémon with the class at [Professor Oak's lab](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Oak%27s_Laboratory "Professor Oak's Laboratory"). Later, Misty and the rest of the group worked together to defeat [Team Rocket](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket_trio "Team Rocket trio"), who Misty was angry to find were still stealing Pokémon. Afterward, the group had a party and learned from [Professor Kukui](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Kukui_(anime) "Professor Kukui (anime)") that the class had plans to head to [Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_City "Cerulean City") for a Gym battle.

In _[When Regions Collide!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM043 "SM043")_, the group arrived at Cerulean City, where Misty and Brock assisted Professor Kukui's lecture on the mechanics of Gym battles and the [Pokémon League](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_League "Pokémon League"). Misty nearly defeated [Lana](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Lana_(anime) "Lana (anime)") and [Mallow](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mallow_(anime) "Mallow (anime)") in a two-on-one battle, but stopped the match before the final blow could be delivered. She then battled against Ash and his [Pikachu](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_Pikachu "Ash's Pikachu") with her [Mega](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mega_Evolution "Mega Evolution")[Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Gyarados "Misty's Gyarados") and lost. She and Brock bade Ash and his classmates farewell and accepted Ash's offer to visit Alola sometime in the future.

[![Image 32](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b2/Lana_and_Misty.png/250px-Lana_and_Misty.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Lana_and_Misty.png)

Misty and Lana

During the time that passed after the visit to Alola, Misty and Lana became close friends, exchanging messages with each other.

In _[Alola, Alola!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM102 "SM102")_, Misty and Brock visited Ash and his classmates in [Alola](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Alola "Alola") after Lana invited them. She also explained that her sisters took charge, and implied that the Cerulean Gym was facing enough challengers that she simply needed a break. Whilst Brock remained at the Pokémon Center, Misty accompanied Ash and the others to [Treasure Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Treasure_Island "Treasure Island"), where they enjoyed [Mantine Surfing](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mantine_Surf "Mantine Surf") and playing with the Pokémon before the villainous obstacle Team Rocket trio attempted to steal the [Mantine](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mantine_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Mantine (Pokémon)"). However, with the help of Gyarados and several [Z-Moves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Z-Move "Z-Move"), she and the others managed to blast Team Rocket off, foiling their every plan.

In _[Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM103 "SM103")_, Misty accompanied Ash, his classmates, and Brock to [Akala Island](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Akala_Island "Akala Island") where they visited [Paniola Ranch](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Paniola_Ranch "Paniola Ranch") and later met [island kahuna](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Island_kahuna "Island kahuna")[Olivia](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Olivia "Olivia"). At the end of the episode, Brock and Misty left Alola to return to Kanto, although not before expressing interest in visiting Alola again.

In _[Destination: Coronation!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN018 "JN018")_, Misty's silhouette was alongside the other Kanto Gym Leaders as the narrator explained how the Gym Leader system works in the [Pokémon world](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_world "Pokémon world").

Misty after catching a Pokémon

In _[Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN139 "JN139")_, Misty and Ash traveled to a diner. After reuniting with [Brock](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brock_(anime) "Brock (anime)") who was working there, they were helped by [Cilan](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cilan_(anime) "Cilan (anime)") to save Brock from the mind control of a wild [Hatterene](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hatterene_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Hatterene (Pokémon)"). After everything was resolved, Brock joined the group and they said goodbye to Cilan who went back to travel alone.

In _[Ride, Lapras, Ride!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN143 "JN143")_, Misty joined Ash to rescue a [Wailmer](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wailmer_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wailmer (Pokémon)") that was trapped in a mountain. During the rescue, the Pokémon evolved into a [Wailord](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wailord_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wailord (Pokémon)"), which made everything more difficult. With Ash's Pokémon, Misty, and Brock, and their respective Trainers working together, they were able to rescue the huge Pokémon.

In _[Getting to the Heart of it All!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN144 "JN144")_, Misty joined Ash to give [Banette](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Banette_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Banette (Pokémon)") a new heart-shaped hair tie. Ash decided that Misty should give her heart-shaped hair tie to Banette, and she agreed. After a long search for Banette, Ash gave Misty's heart-shaped hair tie to [Banette](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Banette_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Banette (Pokémon)"). However, Ash and his friends decided that he and his friends should look for its owner. They scattered around with no hope, leading them to become tired and decide to continue the search the next day. But when Brock realized that Banette's owner was Nurse Joy, they organized a reunion that finally happened.

In _[Rocket Revengers!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN145 "JN145")_, Misty attempted to aid [James's Mime Jr.](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/James%27s_Mime_Jr. "James's Mime Jr."), who seemingly defected from its Trainer, in locating [Officer Jenny](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Officer_Jenny "Officer Jenny") to refer their latest plot. She held off [James's Yamask](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/James%27s_Yamask "James's Yamask") and [Jessie's Frillish](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Jessie%27s_Frillish "Jessie's Frillish") with her Staryu and Psyduck to allow Ash, Pikachu, and Mime Jr. to continue onward. Soon afterward, however, she and the others deduced something was off and then discovered Mime Jr.'s defection was faked as part of a trap against Pikachu. She eventually witnessed [Latias](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Latias_(anime) "Latias (anime)")' appearance, recognizing it from what Ash relayed to her and Brock about his earlier encounter with her. She also witnessed her psychic vision of her friend [Latios](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Latios_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Latios (Pokémon)") escaping confinement.

In _[The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN147 "JN147")_, Misty separated from Ash and Brock to return to Cerulean City.

### Character

[![Image 36](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/27/The_gang.png/220px-The_gang.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:The_gang.png)

Misty and her friends

Misty is a girl who can be sweet and optimistic at times, but she is best known for her vocal frustrations and seething anger. Misty also tended to get very angry whenever [Ash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash_Ketchum "Ash Ketchum") got their party lost, especially in forests. She is very extreme in most of her moods, and she abruptly switches between her emotions. However, as time went on, Misty mellowed and her hyperactive personality was reduced significantly by the end of the [original series](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series"). In the Japanese version, she uses the pronoun Atashi in reference to herself.

She is also picky, sensitive, nosy, and grumpy about love. There are many episodes where she is seen getting along with the younger siblings of the family, namely [Mikey](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mikey "Mikey"), [Sakura](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Sakura "Sakura"), and [Max](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Max "Max"). This stems from the fact that she understands what it's like to be the youngest because she has three older sisters.

She is shown to have a somewhat vain side to her, often referring to herself as an "internationally known beauty" (**世界の美少女**_the world's most beautiful girl_) in introductions to others. It is implied that this trait was a result of her inferiority complex towards her older sisters. However, this trait was mostly excluded from the [dub](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dub "Dub") until [_Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Sun_%26_Moon "Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon").

[![Image 37](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/b4/Misty_and_Ash_Oshawott.png/250px-Misty_and_Ash_Oshawott.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_and_Ash_Oshawott.png)

Misty showing her love for Water-type Pokémon

Her goals are not as clear as those of the other main characters (with the possible exception of Ash), but her main interest is [training](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_training "Pokémon training")[Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") with the dream of becoming a Water [Pokémon Master](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Master "Pokémon Master"). Misty aggressively defends the Water-type against critics as seen in _[The School of Hard Knocks](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP009 "EP009")_ and when she first met [Fire](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fire_(type) "Fire (type)") enthusiast [Macy](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Macy "Macy"). She considers all members of the Water-type to be "cute", though her positive opinion on [Tentacool](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tentacool_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Tentacool (Pokémon)") in _[Tentacool and Tentacruel](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP019 "EP019")_ divided Ash and [Brock](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brock_(anime) "Brock (anime)"). [Fishing](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fishing "Fishing") is one of her hobbies, and she even has a [special lure](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_special_lure "Misty's special lure"), which she designed to look like herself. In _[The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/AG187 "AG187")_, she sent one to Ash as a gift. Sometime before she left for Kanto at the end of _[Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/SM103 "SM103")_, Misty gave Lana another one as thanks for inviting her and Brock to visit Alola.

[![Image 38](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/5/53/Misty_Cascade_Badge.png/250px-Misty_Cascade_Badge.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_Cascade_Badge.png)

Misty holding a Cascade Badge

Misty's battle style was first showcased in _[The Water Flowers of Cerulean City](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP007 "EP007")_, where she challenged Ash. She had her [Staryu](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Staryu "Misty's Staryu") dive into the water to wash off [Butterfree](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ash%27s_Butterfree "Ash's Butterfree")'s [status](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Status_condition "Status condition")-inducing [moves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Move "Move"). Misty has developed a more rounded battle strategy since becoming the full-time Cerulean Gym Leader, mirroring many of Ash's methods. During [_Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_the_Series:_Ruby_and_Sapphire "Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire"), Misty was shown to become increasingly confident and focused on her role as the Cerulean [Gym Leader](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gym_Leader "Gym Leader"). _[Cerulean Blues](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS02 "HS02")_ saw her overcome her fear and help calm a raging [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Gyarados "Misty's Gyarados") which now serves as one of her main Pokémon, while Misty learned about the Gym Badge-making process and began to appreciate her role in _[The Blue Badge of Courage](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/HS05 "HS05")_. She continues to improve her Pokémon as seen with [Psyduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Psyduck "Misty's Psyduck")'s mastery of [Water Gun](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_Gun_(move) "Water Gun (move)") and her [Corsola](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Misty%27s_Corsola "Misty's Corsola")'s strong defenses make for a tireless battle.

[![Image 39](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/8/8d/Misty_fear_of_bugs.png/250px-Misty_fear_of_bugs.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_fear_of_bugs.png)

Misty showing her fear of Bug Pokémon

The one Pokémon [type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Type "Type") that Misty cannot stand are [Bug-types](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bug_(type) "Bug (type)"), as shown in _[Ash Catches a Pokémon!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP003 "EP003")_ and more recently in _[A Squad’s Worth of Passion!](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/JN141 "JN141")_. The only Bug-type Pokémon Misty is not afraid of are the kinds that she deems "cute" or "pretty", like [Ledyba](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ledyba_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Ledyba (Pokémon)") and [Butterfree](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Butterfree_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Butterfree (Pokémon)"), some belonging to her friends, like [Tracey's Venonat](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tracey%27s_Venonat "Tracey's Venonat"), or ones that don't look like bugs, such as [Pineco](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pineco_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Pineco (Pokémon)"). However, Bug Pokémon are only one of three things Misty strongly dislikes, the other two being [carrots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/carrot "wp:carrot") and [peppers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bell_pepper "wp:Bell pepper"). When asked how she feels about dual-typed Bug/Water Pokémon, such as [Dewpider](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dewpider_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Dewpider (Pokémon)"), Misty replied "that's a tough one".

Her catchphrase when sending out a Pokémon is (**いくわよ！マーイステディ！**_Go! My Steady!_). Like her "beauty" title, this was not carried over into the dub until _Sun & Moon_.

Early into the series, she was shown to have a more pragmatic view on battling, which is best demonstrated in the third episode where she agreed to Ash fighting against Team Rocket despite the specific battle technically being illegal because it ultimately had the best chances of Ash not losing quickly, and also her disappointment that Ash proceeded to forfeit against Brock instead of taking the lucky advantage against him during his rematch.

### Pokémon

[![Image 40](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/9/90/Misty_party_JN.png/250px-Misty_party_JN.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:Misty_party_JN.png)

Misty and some of her Pokémon in [_Pokémon Journeys: The Series_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Journeys:_The_Series "Pokémon Journeys: The Series")

Either through the tradition of her family's Gym or merely her love of them, Misty prefers to train [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)") Pokémon. She usually bases her choice of Pokémon to train by looks, preferring Pokémon that she thinks of as "cute" over ones that she thinks are "ugly," but is willing to overcome such differences.

Her love of Water Pokémon stems from the fact that they are extremely flexible in battle, meaning that they can easily adapt to the opponent, as she stated in _[Some Like It Hot](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP240 "EP240")_. Since becoming a Gym Leader, she has overcome her fear of [Gyarados](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Gyarados_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Gyarados (Pokémon)") and continues to learn more about caring and battling with Water Pokémon as challengers come to the [Cerulean Gym](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cerulean_Gym "Cerulean Gym").

As an experienced Water-type Pokémon Trainer, Misty has access to many powerful Pokémon and mechanics such as [Mega Evolution](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Mega_Evolution "Mega Evolution"). This allows her to be able to battle other powerful Trainers like [Dorian](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dorian "Dorian"), [Trinity](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Trinity "Trinity"), or Ash in equal conditions.

He was used with Marina's [Starmie](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Starmie_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Starmie (Pokémon)") to get them back and Golduck throws [Team Rocket's sub](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Team_Rocket%27s_mechas "Team Rocket's mechas") onto the beach. He hits the sub with a Water Gun, and stops [Arbok](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Jessie%27s_Arbok "Jessie's Arbok")'s attack with Disable and then slams Arbok to the floor with a Psychic, and eventually send Team Rocket blasting off with a [Hyper Beam](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hyper_Beam_(move) "Hyper Beam (move)") and saves Marina's Pokémon.

He was later used in the last part of the battle between Marina and her Starmie, he gets battered with Starmie's [Tackle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Tackle_(move) "Tackle (move)") and [Bubble](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bubble_(move) "Bubble (move)") but shatters Starmie's [Light Screen](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Light_Screen_(move) "Light Screen (move)") with another Hyper Beam fainting it. Misty tries to recall Golduck but her Psyduck pops out. Golduck runs off and shows off his skills to a bunch of girls.

Golduck's known moves are [Surf](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Surf_(move) "Surf (move)")*, [Water Gun](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_Gun_(move) "Water Gun (move)"), [Disable](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Disable_(move) "Disable (move)"), [Confusion](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Confusion_(move) "Confusion (move)"), [Psychic](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Psychic_(move) "Psychic (move)")*, [Fury Swipes](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Fury_Swipes_(move) "Fury Swipes (move)"), and [Hyper Beam](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Hyper_Beam_(move) "Hyper Beam (move)").
